headline: Approved a three-step payment plan for the Rhum Bar loan and Part I of the administrative plan.
summary: The group reviewed its accomplishments this year and updates on several loans in its portfolio. It approved a three-step approach for the Rhum Bar loan. It also accepted Part I of the administrative plan as presented.
decisions: Approved the September meeting minutes, all in favor.
Approved Part I of the Administrative Plan as presented, all in favor.

Approved a three-part motion on the Rhum Bar loan: accept a one-time payment if it covers 100% of the owed principal, otherwise make a counteroffer, and otherwise follow the scheduled payment plan, all in favor.

plain_text:
Minutes for GNRLF Meeting 
10/19/26 – noon  
Room 208, Nashua City Hall 
 
 
Attending Committee Members: David Dearborn, Dawn Enwright, Christine Malloy, Stephen Michon, Lyn 
Tripp. Administration: Abimana Ngira, Kathleen Palmer. Absent: Liz Hannum. 
 
Call to Order: 12:07 pm. 
Approval of Minutes: for Sept. Motion to Approve was made by David, seconded by Christine, all in favor; 
approved. 
A few minutes were spent reviewing the accomplishments of the committee thus far this year. Next meeting 
will include discussion of plans for next year’s goals and accomplishments. 
Administrative Plan update: A Motion to Approve made by Dawn to accept as presented Part I of the Admin 
Plan. Seconded by Lyn, all in favor; Part I is set. 
Part II: Abimana requested team review specific points of Part II to start: B1, B3, C1, C2 and D1. 
Call to action: Review Lyn’s delinquency procedure draft before next meeting. 
RLF portfolio update: 
• CA Burrito: no longer a viable partnership with BDC. 
• Bobo’s and Stone Social registered mails were returned undeliverable. 
• San Francisco Kitchen: Lyn will have a decision by next meeting on how to proceed. 
• Rhum Bar: A three-part Motion was made by Dawn:  
1. Motion to Accept a one-time payment IF it satisfies 100% of the owed principal; 
2. If not, a counteroffer is to be made to the borrower for additional money towards the principal;  
3. if that is not accepted by the borrower, proceed with the scheduled payment plan. 
Motion was seconded by Christine; all in favor; approved. 
Meeting Adjourned at 1:15 pm.  
Next meeting: Noon Monday, Nov. 16, in Room 208.
